name: Apply Wall Primer (Roll Method)
intent: Cut in to ceiling line freehand with brush, then roll primer onto bare drywall walls with an 18-inch roller. Single coat of primer regardless of QT — primer never gets a second coat in NC residential. Texture variants (orange peel, knockdown) require slower laydown to fill the profile.
doctrine: Primer cut-in is slower than finish cut-in because the painter is fighting wet primer that can lap-mark visibly even though it's hidden by finish coats — the prime cut-in line establishes where the finish painter will cut in, so straightness matters at QT4. Roll primer rate is texture-driven (smooth 350 vs textured 275 SF/hr). At QT4 the smooth and textured rates collapse to the same value because the slower QT4 laydown dominates the texture difference.
